method: Resolve literal Compile Include paths in frozen Android product csproj, de-duplicate real paths. splitlines counts physical lines including comments blank lines and preprocessor directives; declarations are heuristic locators, not AST-derived LOC. Android conditional blocks contain both selected and excluded arms; they are not savings. Candidate touch ranges unioned per source, no duplicates, are replacement upper bounds, NOT net removed LOC. Tests/docs/generated/compat CompileInventory excluded. No old 111 compile errors or 41 unbound cfg items counted. Android-selected conditional body is the union of active, non-directive lines under any ANDROID-dependent ancestor, evaluating ANDROID+IL2CPP true and other symbols false; comments/blank included. This includes shared logic inside broad #if ANDROID wrappers, not an adaptation-only LOC or savings metric.
